name: Thelesperma

project_scope.note: T. filifolium var. filifolium is represented by canonical T. filifolium. Source-name T. ambiguum maps to the provisional installed T. megapotamicum var. ambiguum concept; its taxonomy/range HOLD remains explicit and native metrics stay excluded.

study_strategy.warning: Do not use the old T. ambiguum source name as proof of a separate species in the learner. The project currently teaches that source concept through provisional T. megapotamicum var. ambiguum while preserving the Kew/ITIS treatment split.
look_here_first: Keep ambiguum provisional until taxonomic review

source literature says T. filifolium var. filifolium

quick_key.if: ambiguum concept; taxonomy sources disagree species vs variety and range threshold is unresolved
quick_key.then: Thelesperma megapotamicum var. ambiguum provisional learner / source alias T. ambiguum

quick_key.if: slender greenthread with the B076 PASS morphology and county set

look_here_first: Photograph the whole greenthread and follow attached lower-to-upper leaves. Repeatedly thread-divided foliage and usually annual habit suggest T. filifolium; sparse foliage, lower leaves with 3–5 narrow segments, simpler upper leaves and perennial crown suggest T. simplicifolium. Examine head underside and ripe fruit. The provisional ambiguum concept cannot be diagnosed from yellow rays or dark disk alone.
